products.short_description: Define the enterprise integration patterns across Entra ID ↔ Google, M365 coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow/SAP/Databricks) — consistent authentication, authorization, and data access, not one-off connections. products.description:
One consistent way to connect Google, Microsoft, and everything else

During and after a Google transformation, authentication, authorization, and data access must stay consistent across Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace, the legacy Microsoft systems in coexistence, and third-party enterprise apps (ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks, and more). This solution defines the enterprise integration patterns — the reference designs for identity federation, provisioning, app SSO, and data access — so integrations are consistent, secure, and don't become a pile of one-off connections.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Integration Overview — the pattern catalog approach: identity federation, provisioning, app SSO/OIDC/SAML, API/data-access, and coexistence, and how each maps to Entra + Google.
  • Reference Patterns — Entra ID ↔ Google (federation + provisioning), M365-during-coexistence, and third-party apps (ServiceNow, SAP, Databricks, etc.) with the recommended authN/authZ and data-access approach for each.
  • Standards & Anti-Patterns — the consistent approach to authentication, authorization, and data access, plus the anti-patterns (per-app snowflakes, credential sprawl) to avoid.
  • 5 supporting scripts — integration-inventory discovery (SSO apps, provisioning, federation), pattern-conformance validation, an integration coverage/exception report, safe remediation guidance, and a scope helper.
  • Testing gates + an Integration-Patterns reference doc and Best Practices for a consolidated, standards-based integration estate.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Consistent, standards-based integration across Google, Microsoft, and third-party apps — stable identity and data access, no snowflake connections — that scales through the transformation and beyond.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWINTEG-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the Entra-side integration estate (SSO, provisioning, federation)
    • GWINTEG-Remediation.ps1 — safely bring a reviewed snowflake toward its target pattern
    • GWINTEG-Report.ps1 — integration coverage / exception report classified against the pattern catalog
    • GWINTEG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build and preview the pilot-scope and pattern-owner groups
    • GWINTEG-Validation.ps1 — check pattern conformance across the Entra-side integration estate

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
